title: Three Years and One Short Plan
subtitle: 可持续发展 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 可持续发展（人与自然·环境保护·可持续发展）
meta: 主题语境：可持续发展（人与自然·环境保护·可持续发展）　|　核心词汇：modernization　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 modernization 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the planner ① drove the modernization that no citizen in the district would have measured, and he said the driving was the whole of the year. The ② modernization, meaning the change itself and not the plan, ran three years and stayed unmeasured in the book; modernization, he said, is the only thing in a district that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ sort of modernization in that district had the same short plan beside it, and the ④ modernization at the far square, meaning the plot they kept for the children to measure and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Modernization, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the planner said the measuring is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the modernization was the whole of the matter, meaning the progress and not the change. The ⑥ modernization, meaning the progress and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; modernization, he said, is either something you drive or the only word that means both change and a progress. He said the progress is the part they remember.

By 1986 the ⑦ modernization had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short plan. The ⑧ modernization of the whole thing, the planner wrote in March, was one district and three years of measuring; modernization, he said, is either the plot at the far square or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ modernization I remember is the modernization measured in the report, which closed in 1988 and is still measured as the quietest in the district. ⑩ Modernization, my mother said in 1990, is the only thing that improves by being measured; all modernization, she said, is a progress that has agreed to look like change. She said the progress was the honest half.

task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 现代化（指街区里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 现代化（指那次现代化本身，与薄薄的图纸相对）
C. 固定搭配：drive the modernization 推进这一次现代化

F. n. 现代化（指规划报告里写到、被测量的那一次）
G. n. 现代化、进步（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: drive the modernization 意为“推进这一次现代化”，1981 年那位规划员把街区里没有一位市民肯测量的一次现代化做了一遍。
modernization 意为“现代化”，指那次现代化本身而不是薄薄的图纸，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被测量。
modernization 意为“现代化”，指街区里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一张薄薄的图纸。
modernization 意为“现代化”，指最远那处广场的留给孩子们丈量的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
modernization 意为“现代化、进步”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这次进步就是那件事的全部。
modernization 意为“进步”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那次现代化，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
modernization 意为“现代化”，指规划报告里写到、被测量的那一次，到 1986 年这一次成了规划报告里的一行。
modernization 意为“现代化之事”，规划员三月写道，整件事的现代化之事是一处街区和三个年份的测量。
modernization 意为“现代化”，我记得的是规划报告里测量过的那一次，1988 年落成了，至今仍被说成街区里最安静的一次。
modernization 为抽象总称，母亲 1990 年说，现代化是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的现代化。
